definitions.explanation: the part of the nervous system that controls involuntary bodily functions such as heart rate, digestion, and breathing

examples.japanese: {自律神経|じりつしんけい}を{整|ととの}える。
ストレスで{自律神経|じりつしんけい}が{乱|みだ}れる。
examples.english: Stress disrupts the autonomic nervous system.

examples.japanese: {自律神経|じりつしんけい}のバランスが{崩|くず}れると{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}しやすい。
examples.english: When the autonomic nervous system is out of balance, you're more likely to feel unwell.

notes:
MEDICAL TERM:
The {自律神経|じりつしんけい} controls functions we don't consciously control.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {交感神経|こうかんしんけい} - sympathetic nervous system (fight or flight)
- {副交感神経|ふくこうかんしんけい} - parasympathetic nervous system (rest and digest)

SYMPTOMS OF IMBALANCE:
- {不眠|ふみん} - insomnia
- {疲労感|ひろうかん} - fatigue
- {頭痛|ずつう} - headache
- めまい - dizziness
- {動悸|どうき} - palpitations

RELATED CONDITION:
- {自律神経失調症|じりつしんけいしっちょうしょう} - autonomic dysfunction

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自律神経|じりつしんけい}を{整|ととの}える - balance the ANS
- {自律神経|じりつしんけい}が{乱|みだ}れる - ANS becomes disturbed
- {自律神経|じりつしんけい}の{働|はたら}き - function of ANS
